likeYou.title: I Like You
likeYou.intro: Nine rounds, two photos each - just pick the one you like more. After nine rounds the list is yours.
likeYou.step1: Each round draws two voice actresses you have not seen yet; the one you pick takes a seat.
likeYou.step2: The other one drops out and never comes back.
likeYou.step3: Nine rounds and you are done - the draw comes from {{total}} candidates, so who shows up is pure luck.
